column2: AN ACT TO INCORPORATE  THE PHILIP GUNAWARDENA

column1: WHEREAS  a  Society  called  and  known  as  the  “Philip
Gunawardena  Commemorative Society” has heretofore been
established  in  Sri  Lanka  for  the  purpose  of  effectually
carrying out its objects and transacting all matters connected
with the said Society according to the rules agreed to by its
members:
AND WHEREAS the said Society has heretofore successfully
carried  out  and  transacted  the  several  objects  and  matters  for
which it was established and has applied to be incorporated and
it will be for the public advantage to grant the said  application:
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Philip  Gunawardena

column1: Commemorative Society (Incorporation) Act, No. 4 of 2014.

column2: From  and  after  the  date  of  commencement  of  this

column1: Act, such and so many persons as now are members of the
“Philip Gunawardena Commemorative Society” (hereinafter
referred to as “the Society”) and shall hereafter be admitted
as members of the Corporation hereby constituted shall be a
body  corporate  with  perpetual  succession  under  the  name
and  style  of  the  “Philip  Gunawardena  Commemorative
Society”  (hereinafter referred to as “the  Corporation”)  and
by  that  name  may  sue  and  be  sued  with  full  power  and
authority to have, and use a common seal and to alter the
same at its pleasure.

column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be —

column2: to research into, foster and promote the philosophy
and thinking of the late Mr. Philip Gunawardena;
